(extension) Peppol participant identity (EAS/endpoint), proxy registration state machine + SML/SMP lookup
(extension) recipient Peppol reachability verification (peppol_verification_state) via SML lookup

behavioral_notes.observation: This is the network bridge. Every Peppol operation is an authenticated HTTPS call to Odoo's Peppol IAP proxy (peppol.api.odoo.com / peppol.test.odoo.com), which fronts a certified Peppol Access Point. _call_peppol_proxy hits versioned endpoints '/api/peppol/1/{send_document,get_all_documents,get_document,ack,register_sender_as_receiver,cancel_peppol_registration,unregister_to_sender}' and '/api/peppol/2/{participant_status,get_services,remove_services,set_webhook}', signing requests with the EDI proxy user's asymmetric key. It defends the link: an 'invalid_signature' reply marks the connection out-of-sync (token desync, refresh_token cleared) and forces a 'Reconnect this database' in Settings; a 'no_such_user' on an inactive user resets the company to 'not_registered'. None of this request/response machinery or its error-recovery is visible in metadata.

Outbound transmission side-effect of Send & Print: after the invoice PDF/UBL is rendered, applicable moves (partner peppol_verification_state=='valid', company in PEPPOL_LIST, proxy_state can-send) are base64-encoded and POSTed in a batch to '1/send_document' addressed to '{peppol_eas}:{peppol_endpoint}'. The proxy returns only message UUIDs, so the code zips them back onto the moves by order, sets peppol_message_uuid + peppol_move_state='processing', logs the sent attachments on the chatter, locks the records, commits, and schedules ir_cron_peppol_get_message_status +5 min. A 64 MB size guard and a ParticipantNotReady error path gate the send. Invoices >'processing'/'done' can no longer be cancelled (action_cancel_peppol_documents guards on peppol_is_sent).

Inbound reception side-effect driven by cron: _cron_peppol_get_new_documents polls '1/get_all_documents' (direction=incoming) for receiver companies, pulls payloads via '1/get_document', AES-decrypts each with _decrypt_data(enc_key), materialises an ir.attachment, and _peppol_import_invoice creates an account.move in the company's peppol_purchase_journal_id (in_invoice) -- or, on a self-billing InvoiceTypeCode 389/527 / CreditNoteTypeCode 261, an out_invoice in a sale journal -- then _extend_with_attachments + _autopost_bill parse the UBL into lines (reusing account_edi_ubl_cii) and the message is ACKed via '1/ack'. Post-processing notifies the journal and verifies sender partners. Acknowledgement is deliberate: only successfully saved documents are ACKed so nothing is lost on error.

Participant registration is a multi-step state machine over the proxy: a company moves not_registered -> sender -> smp_registration -> receiver (also rejected), where registering as receiver POSTs the migration_key + supported document identifiers (Peppol BIS Billing UBL Invoice/CreditNote, self-billing, NLCIUS) to '1/register_sender_as_receiver' and flips state to smp_registration. _cron_peppol_get_participant_status (weekly, but self-re-triggered hourly while any company is in smp_registration) calls '2/participant_status' to learn when the SMP publication completes and promotes the company to 'receiver', or archives/resets the user on a 'client_gone'. _get_company_info_on_peppol additionally queries the live SMP service to detect if the identifier is already registered under another (non-Odoo) access-point provider and blocks double-registration.

Before any send, the recipient is verified against the live Peppol network: _peppol_lookup_participant does a NAPTR-DNS-based SML lookup (through the Odoo proxy '1/lookup', with a legacy direct hash/base32 SMP URL on edelivery.tech.ec.europa.eu) and _check_document_type_support confirms the partner's SMP advertises the exact CustomizationID for the chosen format. The result is cached company-dependently on res.partner.peppol_verification_state (valid / not_valid / not_valid_format / not_verified) and drives both the Send & Print alerts and whether 'peppol' is even offered as a sending method. This is a real external lookup, not a stored attribute.

behavioral_notes.element: external integrations (gap #7) — Peppol Access Point / EDI proxy
behavioral_notes.observation: account_peppol is a canonical gap #7 external-integration module: 3 outbound HTTP call sites using the `requests` SDK (no stored API keys; auth is via the EDI proxy user's asymmetric signing) talk to Odoo's Peppol IAP at https://peppol.api.odoo.com (prod) / https://peppol.test.odoo.com (test) plus the European SML/SMP DNS infrastructure, and 4 inbound webhook controllers (/peppol/webhook/new-message, message-state-update, user-state-update, public; /peppol/authentication/callback, user) let the access point push message/participant state changes back. The whole module's reason to exist is this connection to the Peppol four-corner network; the sibling account_edi_ubl_cii only builds the XML and explicitly defers transmission to here.

it_architecture.application: account_peppol (Peppol Access Point connector: sends/receives e-invoices over the Peppol network via the Odoo EDI proxy)
logical_data_erm: res.company -> account_edi_proxy_client.user (account_peppol_edi_user; one peppol user per company)
peppol.config.wizard -> account_peppol.service (one2many, document types to register)
account.move -> account_edi_proxy_client.user (sent via company's peppol user; peppol_message_uuid)
information_flows: depends: account_edi_proxy_client (signed proxy transport), account_edi_ubl_cii (the UBL/CII XML it ships)
outbound: account.move.send (Send & Print) -> _send_peppol_documents -> HTTPS '1/send_document' to Peppol IAP -> Access Point -> recipient corner; status polled back via '1/get_document' + cron
inbound: _cron_peppol_get_new_documents -> '1/get_all_documents'+'1/get_document' (decrypt) -> account.move in peppol_purchase_journal_id -> _autopost_bill (parses UBL via account_edi_ubl_cii)
registration: peppol.registration -> proxy '1/register_sender_as_receiver' -> state machine not_registered->sender->smp_registration->receiver; participant_status polled by cron
push-back: Peppol IAP -> webhook controllers (/peppol/webhook/*) -> new-message / message-state / user-state updates
frontend_components: WhatIsPeppol (OWL dialog explaining/activating Peppol on Send & Print)
external_integrations: Odoo Peppol IAP proxy (prod https://peppol.api.odoo.com, test https://peppol.test.odoo.com) fronting a certified Peppol Access Point — register/send/receive/ack/participant_status/lookup over signed HTTPS (account_edi_proxy_client asymmetric key, requests SDK, no stored API key)
European SML/SMP service-discovery infrastructure (NAPTR DNS, *.edelivery.tech.ec.europa.eu) for participant + capability lookup

Inbound webhooks from the access point: /peppol/webhook/new-message, /peppol/webhook/message-state-update, /peppol/webhook/user-state-update (public, signed token) and /peppol/authentication/callback (user)

capabilities: Register as a Peppol participant (sender / receiver) via the Odoo Access Point
Send invoices & credit notes over the Peppol network
Receive vendor bills (and self-billed invoices) over the Peppol network into accounting journals
Verify trading-partner reachability & supported formats on Peppol (SML/SMP lookup)
Track per-document delivery status (processing / done / error) and participant status
value_streams: Onboard to Peppol: configure EAS/endpoint -> register sender -> register as receiver -> SMP publication -> can send & receive
Outbound: posted customer invoice -> verify recipient on Peppol -> UBL built (account_edi_ubl_cii) -> transmitted via Access Point -> delivery status reconciled onto the move
Inbound: peer sends document -> cron/webhook fetch -> decrypt -> vendor bill (or self-billed customer invoice) created & parsed in the Peppol journal -> ACK
policies: Peppol offered as a sending method only when company country is in PEPPOL_LIST and proxy state is sender/smp_registration/receiver (not not_registered/in_verification/rejected)
A document is sent over Peppol only if the recipient's peppol_verification_state is 'valid' (live SML check); else a Send & Print alert is raised
Connection-integrity policy: invalid_signature -> mark connection out-of-sync + require 'Reconnect this database'; superseded -> disconnect & re-register
Only successfully-saved inbound documents are ACKed; participant-status cron self-throttles (hourly during smp_registration, weekly otherwise)
Sent (processing/done) invoices can no longer be cancelled
stakeholders: Accountant / AR clerk (sends compliant e-invoices, monitors delivery status)
AP clerk (receives and auto-posts vendor bills from Peppol)
Customer / supplier trading partner (the receiving/sending corner on Peppol)
Odoo Peppol IAP / certified Access Point operator (the service provider corner)
Peppol Authority / national tax mandates (regulatory driver behind the network)

classification.rationale: value_model 'network' (Stabell & Fjeldstad mediating/value-network logic): account_peppol's entire reason to exist is to connect the company to its trading partners over the Peppol four-corner e-delivery network through a certified Access Point (the Odoo EDI proxy at peppol.api.odoo.com). It performs the three signature activities of a mediating technology — (1) network promotion & contract management = participant registration and the SML/SMP capability lookup that establishes who can be reached (peppol.registration, _peppol_register_sender_as_receiver, _peppol_lookup_participant); (2) service provisioning = relaying invoices/credit-notes/bills between corners (_send_peppol_documents, _peppol_get_new_documents); (3) network infrastructure operation = maintaining the signed proxy connection, webhooks and the status-polling crons. Value rises with the size of the reachable Peppol network (a classic network-effect mediator), and the module mediates between many parties rather than transforming inputs (chain) or solving a client problem (shop). It is deliberately distinguished from its sibling account_edi_ubl_cii, which only serializes/parses the XML (support) and explicitly defers network transmission to here. activity_class is 'support': although it has network value-configuration logic, within the firm it is an infrastructure/compliance enabler bolted onto Accounting (no app, headless except a Send & Print dialog, no primary revenue activity of its own). APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources — specifically the document-exchange edge of 9.2.x process accounts receivable (transmit customer invoices) and 9.5.x process accounts payable (receive vendor bills); it transports the statutory documents that 'account' posts.

standard_capabilities: Register a company as a Peppol sender, then as a receiver, through Odoo's built-in certified Access Point (no third-party AP contract needed)
Send customer invoices & credit notes over Peppol directly from Send & Print (UBL BIS 3 / NLCIUS built by account_edi_ubl_cii)
Receive and auto-post vendor bills (and self-billed invoices) from Peppol into a dedicated purchase/sale journal via cron
Live trading-partner reachability + format-support check against the SML/SMP before sending
Per-document delivery-status tracking and connection self-healing (out-of-sync detection, reconnect, webhooks)
typical_fits: EU/EEA company in a Peppol-mandate country (BE, NL, NO, SE, FI, LU, LV, ...) that must send/receive structured e-invoices
Company that wants turnkey Peppol access without procuring its own Access Point (uses the Odoo IAP)
Automatic vendor-bill capture from suppliers already on Peppol
Self-billing exchange where the customer issues the invoice over Peppol
common_gaps: Connecting via a non-Odoo / external Access Point provider (the module is built around the Odoo IAP; an already-registered external provider is detected and blocks re-registration)
Peppol document types beyond invoicing (orders, despatch advice, etc.) — only the billing BIS/NLCIUS identifiers are registered by default
Country-specific clearance/CTC models that sit alongside or instead of Peppol (e.g. national platforms)
Air-gapped / on-prem deployments where outbound HTTPS to peppol.api.odoo.com is unavailable
Custom routing of inbound self-billed vs standard documents beyond the default journal logic

open_questions: Exact Peppol IAP API contract & SLA behind peppol.api.odoo.com (server-side Access Point), which is out of repo scope.
How webhook-driven updates (/peppol/webhook/*) interleave with the polling crons in production, and the dedup/ordering guarantees.
Full set of registrable document identifiers once country/extra modules extend _peppol_modules_document_types beyond the default billing set.
Behaviour of the asymmetric token desync / reconnect flow across DB duplication and multi-database neutralization in real deployments.
